name: nd_statute
description: Get the FULL TEXT of a section of the North Dakota Century Code — North Dakota state law — by citation. "12.1-16-01" is murder; "47-16-13.1" is a landlord's duty to maintain a rental unit. Accepts natural forms: "12.1-16-01", "NDCC 12.1-16-01", "§ 12.1-16-01". Returns the current statutory text, the official catchline, and chapter/title context. North Dakota publishes the CURRENT text only — no per-year historical archive and no general amendment-history field (a repealed or redesignated section's one-line session-law citation is included in the text as-is); this tool says so rather than guessing. Keyless. Use for "what does NDCC 12.1-16-01 say" or to check a North Dakota statute a case or lease relies on.

citation.description: Section citation, title-chapter-section, e.g. "12.1-16-01" (murder) or "47-16-13.1" (landlord maintenance duty). Some sections carry a decimal suffix, e.g. "47-16-07.3".

name: nd_search
description: Search the North Dakota Century Code BY TOPIC or keyword rather than citation — "landlord security deposit", "concealed weapon permit", "homicide". Matches against the Legislature's own official section and chapter CATCHLINES across the whole Code (not full statutory prose — North Dakota does not publish a full-text search of Code section text, verified live), e.g. "landlord" surfaces sections like "Landlord obligations - Maintenance of premises" even though no CHAPTER is named "Landlord and Tenant". Returns matching citations and catchlines; call nd_statute with a citation for the full text. Keyless.

query.description: Topic or keywords, e.g. "landlord security deposit".

limit.description: Max results to return, default 10, max 25.
